acceptanceCriteria: A CPU profile at the 16,384-test fixture attributes the secret-screen cost.
Either the screen cost drops measurably with unchanged refusals, or the ticket records why it cannot.
body: Measured in the V1-1676 lane (PR #1084): at the 16,384-test ceiling, affected --selection-profile e2e-safe took 7.49 s, of which about 2 s was the secret screen in the provider document Decode. Expected: the screen scales with the bytes it must inspect, not repeated per field. Actual: about 27% of the wall time. Unconfirmed profile; the measurement was a lane observation.
title: affected e2e-safe: the Decode secret screen costs about 2 s of 7.5 s at the 16,384-test ceiling
